purpose: Reproducible public-data research queue before primary-evidence investment review
formula_family: Same corporate/insurer/other-financial Value, Quality and Momentum formulas as vqm-fundamental 1.0.0; vendor accounting and taxonomy are a distinct input contract
taxonomy: Yahoo sector and industry, retained verbatim; banks and equity REITs require unavailable specialized components and remain explicitly unranked
accounting: Latest vendor quarterly income period through price date, four consecutive quarters, matching balance/cash-flow periods, USD only; no discretionary addbacks
issuer_rule: Group dated constituent company names or supplied stable issuer IDs; highest ADV20 class, then symbol ascending; missing class liquidity blocks the issuer
market_cap: Vendor marketCap scaled by frozen close / vendor regularMarketPrice; a proxy holding claims and shares constant, not audited issuer-wide capital
enterprise_value: Vendor enterpriseValue plus price-bridged cap minus vendor marketCap; no invented preferred/NCI zeros
missing_data: No zero imputation, weight redistribution, manual substitutions or silent alternative profile. Retain every constituent and every exclusion.
review_queue: All scored issuers in score order. Review every issuer before the selection frontier; no cherry-picked subset or promotion based on work completed.
candidate_count: User supplied; no hard-coded top-five or top-ten list
eligible_selection: Separate existing screen_review evidence and horizon gates; public queue never supplies Eligible or Strong Buy
